title: Privacy+
description: Protects your privacy by showing fake coordinates instead of the real ones.
body:
# Privacy+

## Features
- Hide real coordinates on your screen (F3 Debug, Chat, HUD, Targeted Block).
- Changes real coordinates to fake ones.
- Only works on client-side, doesn't affect the server.

## Config Options
- Enable/Disable Mod
- Masking mode (always mask or only on screenshot)
- Offset Magnitude
- Hide F3 Debug Right Panel
- Even more!

## Where it can be used?
You can use it anywhere if you want to prevent coordinates from leaking by mistake.  
Main purposes are to protect your valuable bases & farms!

Check [Gallery](https://modrinth.com/mod/privacy+/gallery) & [Changelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/privacy+/changelog).

Dependencies : [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) & [YACL](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)
